title: All Aluminum Trolling Motor Stabilizer Mount, Greater Support with 1.5" Ball for 1.09" to 2.09" Rails, 360° Adjustable, Compatible with Minn Kota, Rhodan and More Boat Trolling Motor
description:
Heavy Duty - The trolling motor stabilizer mount can be up to 15.5 lbs at rest and 4.5 lbs at motion to ensure you trolling motor is securely supported when heading to or returning from a fishing trip. The 1.5" ball and 5.9" double socket arm provide greater clamping strength and range, ensuring your trolling motor won't slip off due to boat vibration and wave impact.
Wide Range of Applications - The trolling motor mount works with all types of boats such as kayak, center consoles, pontoon boats, flats boats, bass boats and more. Great for mounting trolling motors, live scope transducers pole, fishing rod holders and more. Compatible with Minn Kota, Newport, Garmin and more electronic device (Complimentary 3 sets of 316 marine grade stainless steel machine screws, lock nuts and sheet metal screws).
Designed for High Salt Marine Environment - Constructed of powder-coated marine-grade aluminum and stainless steel hardware. The mount has been Salt Spray Tested for thousands of hours (including stainless steel bolts and springs) to resist high salt water corrosion and remain strong and durable even under the impact of waves.
Universal Design - Includes a C size 5.9" length 1.5" double socket arm, a 2.4" diameter Adjustable Mounting Pattern Standard (AMPS) hole pattern round base and a tough-claw clamp base with a gripping range of 1.09" - 2.09". The ball and socket technology allows for near-infinite adjustability. Perfectly compatible with RAM Mounts, Arkon, iBolt and other 1.5 inches / C size / 38 mm adapters and arms.
360° Rotation - Bow trolling motor support swivels 360° to accommodate different angles of trolling motor shafts. The rubber pad provide stable gripping and protect mounting surfaces.

title: Offshore Trolling Fishing Rod Holder with Enlarge Clamp for Boat, Innovative 1S Quick Release (Blue)
description:
Dual-Mount Versatility – Easily switch between horizontal and vertical mounting on boat rails or gunwales (0"-3.35" thickness) by simply loosening the knob—no tools required!
Instant Lock/Release for On-the-Fly Fishing - The innovative base design locks firmly in place with a simple push-and-twist motion. Press the release button for instant removal, allowing fast repositioning anywhere on your boat.
Instant Rod Lift for Hooksets – Effortlessly raise your rod with the one-touch lever on the rod butt holder, ensuring quick and smooth hooksetting during trolling.
Big-Game Tough, Saltwater Strong – Engineered with high-impact Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) and marine-grade stainless steel, it laughs off 400+ lbs of downward force and resists UV/salt corrosion. Built for tuna, marlin, and rough offshore conditions.
Precision Adjustability – The rod holder head locks securely at a 25° left or right angle, while the vertical tilt adjusts from 10° to 25°, perfect for trolling techniques.
Non-Slip Silicone Padding – Thick silicone lining prevents scratches and wear on rod handles and blanks, even during violent strikes or rough seas.

title: Kayak Camera Mount with 1.5" Track Ball & Extended Arm, Heavy Duty DSLR/Action Camera Mount, Compatible with GoPro, Mirrorless Cameras, Kayak Photography Accessories
description:
Package Includes - The kayak camera mount includes an 18.3" long aluminum arm, a 1.5" ball T-track base, a 1.5" ball adapter with 1/4"-20 threaded screw, an aluminum sports camera mount adapter, and an aluminum phone mount adapter (with secure strap) for solo live streaming.
Three Mounting Configurations - (1) a standard 1/4"-20 threaded screw compatible with Canon, Nikon, and most DSLR/mirrorless cameras; (2) an action camera adapter compatible with GoPro, DJI Osmo, and other action cameras; and (3) a universal phone mount compatible with iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, and other smartphones measuring 2.3"–3.6" in width and up to 0.51" in thickness (with case) to facilitate hands-free live broadcasting.
Superior Compatibility - The track ball with T-bolt attachment designed for track mounting systems including most integrated kayak tracks and other third party track systems. Perfectly fits 1.5 inches / C size arm systems. Compatible with RAM Mounts, Arkon, iBolt and others.
Heavier-Duty - This product features a 1.5" ball, which is more stable than a 1" ball, providing steadier footage for professional shooting and live streaming. The 1.5" diameter tube offers stable support for DSLR cameras. Constructed of high-grade aluminum and high-performance composites, this mount offers a rock solid hold without adding more weight.
Adjust As You Like - The mounting base features rubber friction washers and stainless steel T-bolts. Simply insert it into the track and turn the ball clockwise to tighten. Quickly change the position of the holder by twisting the ball counterclockwise. And the ball and socket technology allows for 360 degree adjustability, enabling perfect framing for your live streams and recordings.

title: WINDFRD 90° Aluminum Boat Track Mount Base – Heavy-Duty Marine Bracket Compatible with Lund Sport Track, Versatrack, Tracker, Ranger & Lowe, Compatible with RAM Accessory (Large)

Ultra-Durable T6 Aluminum - Precision CNC-machined from high-strength T6 marine-grade aluminum alloy. Featuring an anodized finish for superior corrosion resistance, this bracket is built to withstand the harshest saltwater and freshwater environments without cracking or rusting. The heavy-duty bolt-on design provides a rock-solid, vibration-proof connection that outperforms thumb-screw alternatives—perfect for high-speed trolling and supporting heavy downriggers.
Dual-Side Installation - This mount allows installation on both the vertical and horizontal faces simultaneously, maximizing space utilization and functionality.
